display_long_description:
The Ultimate Mixed Reality Chess Experience - MR Chess brings the world’s greatest strategy game into your living room with unparalleled realism. By blending your physical environment with high-fidelity digital assets, we’ve created an over-the-board experience that feels truly authentic.

LICHESS SUPPORT - The feature you’ve been waiting for is here! Connect your Lichess account to play rated games against millions of players worldwide. Watch your opponent's moves manifest on your real-world table, bringing the digital competitive scene into your physical space.

Finally HAPTIC feedback
This application was developed with authentic interactions in mind.
After table calibration your UI will be displayed on your real table transforming it to a huge smartscreen.
Additionally our EXPERIMENTAL mode lets you play with a real chessboard thereby allowing the real haptic chess-playing experience, where you can feel all of your chess-pieces and move them naturally. 
Controllers are never needed.

Perfectly blending REALITY and VIRTUALITY
MR Chess extends your real environment with digital elements such as your playing partner and his chess pieces. Depending on if you are playing with a physical chessboard and physical pieces these assets are either part of your reality or the digital virtuality.

Due to the MIXED REALITY focus we recommend using the application with Quest Pro or Quest 3.
